title: Design Work Inclusions Sheet: Revisions, Renderings, Models and the Design Fee

# Design Work Inclusions Sheet: Revisions, Renderings, Models and the Design Fee

For each programme of Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions the sheet gives the number of design revisions included in the quoted total, the charge for each design revision beyond that number, the business days between the consultation and the first design being presented, whether a computer rendering of the design is prepared within the quoted total, whether a wax or resin model is prepared for the customer to see within the quoted total, the fee charged for the design work itself, and whether that fee is credited against the quoted total once the customer goes ahead.

## Inclusions by programme

| Programme | Design revisions included | Charge per additional revision | Design lead time (business days) | Computer rendering included | Wax or resin model included | Design fee | Design fee credited against the quoted total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | 1 | USD 125.00 | 5 | yes | no | USD 0.00 | yes |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | 2 | USD 175.00 | 7 | yes | no | USD 250.00 | yes |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | 3 | USD 250.00 | 10 | yes | yes | USD 750.00 | yes |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | 4 | USD 350.00 | 14 | yes | yes | USD 1500.00 | yes |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | 3 | USD 275.00 | 12 | yes | yes | USD 950.00 | yes |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | 6 | USD 600.00 | 21 | yes | yes | USD 5000.00 | no |

## Questions the sheet answers

**Which programmes prepare a wax or resin model within the quoted total?** Belrose Bespoke Design, the Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission, the Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission and the Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission. The two Design Studio programmes prepare a computer rendering only.

**Is the design fee credited on every programme that charges one?** It is credited on every programme except the Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission, whose design fee of USD 5000.00 is not credited against the quoted total. The Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting charges no design fee (USD 0.00).

**What does a fourth revision cost on a programme that includes three?** Under Belrose Bespoke Design, which includes 3 revisions, the fourth carries the programme's charge for an additional revision, USD 250.00; under the Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission, which also includes 3, it carries USD 275.00.
